Near the Bourse · metro line 3, Bourse station.

items.q: How long to get a reply?
items.a: Within 4 hours on business days, in English or French. Nights and weekends, we read but don't reply.

items.q: Can I see FleetAi in action before signing up?
items.a: Yes — the demo is freely accessible on a sample fleet, no sign-up needed. To talk about your own fleet, write to us through the form: we reply within 4 business hours.
Yes, the team is bilingual EN/FR. If you write in English, we'll reply in English.

items.q: I'm an integrator / consultant, do you have a partner programme?
items.a: Yes, contact partners@fleetai.app — 20% commission on the first year.

items.q: I have a bug. Where do I write?
items.a: If you're a customer, from the app (icon bottom right) — otherwise support@fleetai.app. Critical bugs handled within 6h.
